item.title: Oil prices slide on hopes of US-Iran peace deal
item.description: Trump said on Saturday that an agreement would include the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, without giving further details.

item.title: Large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine leaves four dead and dozens injured
item.description: A hypersonic missile, which reportedly travels over 10 times the speed of sound, was used, Russia has confirmed.

item.title: Clashes as Venezuelan prisoners protest over alleged mistreatment
item.description: The prisoners insisted their protest was peaceful but that security forces deployed to quell it opened fire.

item.title: Man killed in shark attack off Australia's north-east coast
item.description: The 39-year-old was fatally injured at a shoal off the Cassowary Coast in Queensland, apparently while spearfishing.

item.title: Ebola outbreak poses massive challenges, warns nurse
item.description: Kate White says she is "extremely concerned about the inability to get resources" to the Democratic Republic of Congo.
